about.subtitle: A smart long-document proofreading desktop application built with Electron, Vue 3, and TypeScript

intro.title: Introduction
intro.desc1: AutoDocxProofread (Smart Proofreading) is a desktop application designed for long document proofreading and thesis format optimization. It helps users effectively detect typos, punctuation errors, grammar issues, and text consistency problems in Word documents, and provides modification suggestions. It also supports text polishing to reduce AI detection rates, and offers cross-document format cloning for one-click full-text formatting.
intro.desc2: To address the forgetting and hallucination problems of large models when processing long documents, the software designs a specialized architecture to enhance proofreading accuracy and can export corrected documents with one click. The software also adopts a parallel processing architecture, significantly improving the speed of large model processing for long documents. In addition, a local knowledge base feature is introduced, supporting RAG functionality for model proofreading reference. For the reduce AI detection rate feature, the software uses segmented parallel operations, dividing documents by natural paragraphs and processing them in parallel with large models.
intro.feature1WordError: Sentence-by-Sentence: suitable for short texts requiring high-precision proofreading
intro.feature1Comprehensive: Paragraph-by-Paragraph: suitable for proofreading long documents
intro.feature1Polish: Full Document Proofreading: one-time proofreading for the entire document
intro.feature3Create: Create and manage multiple local knowledge bases
intro.feature3Import: Support importing PDF, Word, and TXT documents as reference materials
intro.feature3RAG: RAG retrieval-augmented generation algorithm based on vector database
intro.feature4Parallel: Uses parallel processing to optimize efficiency, significantly improving proofreading speed for long texts
intro.feature4Display: Clear error display and modification suggestions
intro.feature4Apply: One-click apply modification suggestions and export corrected documents
intro.feature4Responsive: Adjustable correction parameters to suit different task scenarios
intro.feature5OpenAI: Compatible with OpenAI interface, supports multiple LLM APIs
intro.feature5Flexible: Flexible API configuration management, with concurrency and request rate settings
intro.feature6View: Clearly view history including time, proofreading model, file path, and specific results
intro.feature7L1: Adjust language style of AI-generated text to sound more human-written
intro.feature7L2: Reduce the probability of text being flagged by AI detection tools
intro.feature7L3: Preserve original meaning while optimizing expression style
intro.feature8L1: Extract paragraph styles and text styles from reference documents
intro.feature8L2: Batch apply extracted formatting to target documents
intro.feature8L3: Fine-tune format details including font, color, spacing, and more
intro.warningDesc: The accuracy of proofreading results largely depends on model capabilities. The software cannot guarantee completely accurate proofreading results; manual verification is still required.
intro.warningDesc2: The reduce AI detection feature is not guaranteed to be effective. Please strictly follow academic ethics and review the results yourself.
intro.warningDesc3: The format migration feature cannot migrate individually set formats within paragraphs; manual adjustment is required.
intro.tip1Desc: The result export feature may have omissions; manual verification is recommended.
intro.tip2Desc: Based on current large model context memory, top-tier models can directly use full document proofreading for content under 10,000 characters.
intro.tip3Desc: For both reduce AI detection and proofreading features, it is recommended to set heading levels in Word first for better document segmentation.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.step1L3: Fill in API address, key, and model name
guide.step2L1: Click "Knowledge Base" in the navigation bar
guide.step2L2: Select "Embedding Model" (a dedicated embedding model is required)
guide.step2L3: Click "Add Knowledge Base" to create a new knowledge base
guide.step2L4: After selecting a knowledge base, you can add PDF files as reference materials
guide.step3L3: Click "Select DOCX File" to choose a Word document to proofread
guide.step3L4: (Optional) Select a knowledge base to enhance proofreading accuracy
guide.step3L6: Click "Start Proofread" to begin the proofreading process
guide.step3L7: View proofreading results and suggestions in the right sidebar
guide.step3L8: Click "Apply Changes" to accept suggested modifications
guide.step3L9: Click "Export Result" to save the modified document
guide.step4L1: Click prompt settings in the "Feature Settings" page to select different correction parameters such as text background, correction strictness, and error types
guide.step4L2: You can also use your own prompts; when using custom prompts, the original prompts will be disabled. It is recommended to modify based on the original prompts, otherwise it may affect the display effect
guide.step4L3: Click "Restore Default Configuration" to reset the above settings
guide.step5L2: Click "Reduce AI Detection" in the proofreading mode options
guide.step5L4: After results are generated, you can choose to accept or reject them
guide.step5L5: Click "Export Result" to export the results
guide.step6L1: After opening a file, click the "Format Clone" button to switch to format clone mode
guide.step6L2: Click "Select Reference Document" in the left sidebar to select the reference document
guide.step6L3: Click the "Start Clone" button in the upper right corner to begin cloning
guide.step6L4: The left sidebar shows the extracted format information from the reference document, and you can fine-tune parameters like color, font size, and line spacing
guide.step6L5: Click "Export Result" to export the results
